capabilities: Send cloze, Q/A, multiple-choice, code-practice and image-occlusion cards to Anki
Sync the current note, the whole vault, or automatically on save
Update existing Anki notes through stable file and card IDs
Override deck and tags in note frontmatter
Preview syncs and diagnose duplicate IDs
extras: Desktop only: needs Anki Desktop running with the AnkiConnect add-on (add-on code 2055492159) and Obsidian Desktop 1.5.7 or later.
problem: Flashcards written inside Obsidian notes cannot reach Anki on their own, so cards and their review history have to be rebuilt by hand.

relations.evidence: sends flashcards written in your Markdown notes to Anki through AnkiConnect
Anki Desktop, the AnkiConnect add-on, and Obsidian Desktop 1.5.7 or later are required

summary: Syncs flashcards written in Markdown — cloze, Q/A, multiple choice, code practice and image occlusion — into Anki via AnkiConnect.
